fields.Name: Voting Election Scheduler - every 5 minutes
fields.Description: Opens and closes elections on schedule.

fields.Name: Voting Result Snapshot Publisher - every 5 minutes
fields.Description: Publishes running-results snapshots when each election's batch policy allows.

fields.Name: Voting Reminder Sender - hourly
fields.Description: Reminds non-voters at each election's reminder thresholds. Requires VOTING_EMAIL_PROVIDER and VOTING_EMAIL_FROM (or ProviderName/From in Configuration). Ships Disabled: enable it after configuring an email provider (VOTING_EMAIL_PROVIDER / VOTING_EMAIL_FROM or ProviderName / From in its Configuration).
